subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

The organisation’s __furtive__ actions must be taken into notice and dealt with accordingly.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"furtive"** means attempting to avoid notice or attention, typically because of guilt or a belief that discovery would lead to trouble; secretive. (गुप्त)

 
 
• **Example: **He cast a furtive glance at the woman before quickly looking away.
 
 
 
• **"Truthful"** refers to someone who is honest and always tells the truth. (सत्यवादी)
 
 
• **Example: **She is known for her truthful nature and never lies to anyone.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'furtive'** is **'truthful'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Foxy** (चालाक): Cunning or sly.

 
 
• **Example:** The detective had to be foxy to outsmart the criminal.
 
 
 
• **Shady** (संदिग्ध): Of doubtful honesty or legality.
 
 
• **Example:** His shady business practices eventually led to his downfall.
 
 
 
• **Futuristic** (भविष्यवादी): Having or involving very modern technology or design.
 
 
• **Example:** The new building has a very futuristic look.
 
 

46:T8e1,

The correct answer is: **Option 1**.
